title: Agent Team Runtime
description: The Lead coordinates persistent teammates while the runtime owns message delivery, atomic task claims, and task-bound worktree directories.

steps.content: Refactor authentication and update its dependent tests in parallel without mixing the edits.
steps.annotation: The user states the outcome and parallel-edit boundary, not an implementation-specific worktree procedure.

steps.content: I propose a backend teammate for authentication and a test teammate that picks up the dependent checks once they are ready. Shall I start the team?
steps.annotation: The Lead makes the extra-agent decision visible before spawning.
The team starts only after explicit confirmation.
The shared task board remains the source of ownership and status.
The runtime-generated task ID is carried into every later operation on this task.
The worktree directory is recorded on the task instead of managed as a separate workflow or security sandbox.
The task graph keeps dependent work from starting early.

steps.content: Created task_1712345678_0043: Update authentication tests (blockedBy: task_1712345678_0042)
steps.annotation: The second generated ID names the dependent task that the test teammate will later claim.

steps.content: {"name":"backend","role":"backend engineer","prompt":"Claim the authentication task and propose a plan."}
steps.annotation: A persistent teammate receives focused work through the team runtime.

steps.content: {"name":"tests","role":"test engineer","prompt":"Watch the board and claim the dependent test task when it becomes ready."}
steps.annotation: A second persistent teammate can wait in IDLE without another direct dispatch.
Typed correlation and an approval gate protect mutating tools.
The ownership check and state transition are atomic.
Bash, read, and write derive their directory from the claimed task binding.
Completing the first task makes its dependent test task ready.

steps.content: backend -> Lead: result(auth refactor complete) -> idle_notification
steps.annotation: Result and idle state are separate events; the teammate remains available.
An idle teammate discovers newly ready work without another direct assignment.

steps.content: tests -> Lead: result(test suite passed) -> idle_notification
steps.annotation: The runtime wakes the Lead when mailbox events arrive instead of asking the model to poll.

steps.content: Authentication was refactored in its task-bound worktree and the dependent tests pass.
steps.annotation: The Lead combines parallel results into one user-facing outcome.
